name: Surface Rendering with Scatter Accumulation
definition: A rendering pass that queries surface properties (albedo, BRDF, normals) at hit points and scatters them into per-ray maps using a scatter operation, handling optional noise jittering and relighting outputs.
summary: Surface Rendering with Scatter Accumulation is a rendering pass that queries surface properties at ray-object hits and scatters them into per-ray maps, differing from volume-based splatting by operating exclusively on discrete surface intersections.
